## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Adelaide, Australia. It starts at Gorge Wildlife Park, 30 Redden Drive.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Visit the Gorge Wildlife Park, established in 1965 and still managed by the same family. Walk through 14 acres of land shaded by trees. Follow paths leading to one of the largest privately owned collections of Australian and exotic animals, birds, and reptiles in the country. Get close to the wildlife for an unforgettable experience.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €18.66. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 4 ratings and 4 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
